'''Droid Services''' was a commercial facility located in the upper levels of [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As a government contractor employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they handled both the refurbishment and reassignment of droids, including those previously used in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]].
